units.title: Freud
units.blurb: Sigmund Freud's theories of the mind, and how later research judged them.

units.title: Philosophy and Religion
units.blurb: Volume 55: eight thinkers of the 20th century.

units.title: Natural Science
units.blurb: Volume 56: relativity, the atom, the expanding universe, genes and life.

units.title: Social Science
units.blurb: Volumes 57 and 58: economics, sociology, anthropology and history.

units.title: Imaginative Literature
units.blurb: Volumes 59 and 60: stories, plays and poems of the 20th century.

topics.title: Freud: The Interpretation of Dreams
topics.short: Freud's claim that dreams have hidden meanings, its place in history, and what later research found.

topics.title: Freud: The Later Works
topics.short: The unconscious, the id, ego and superego, and Freud's view of civilization, with their critics.

topics.title: William James: Pragmatism
topics.short: An idea's meaning lies in the difference it makes in practice; truth is what works out in experience.

topics.title: Bergson: An Introduction to Metaphysics
topics.short: Two ways of knowing: analysis from outside, and intuition that enters into a thing's living flow.

topics.title: Russell: The Problems of Philosophy
topics.short: Is the table really there? A short, clear tour of what we can know, and why philosophy is worth it.

topics.title: Whitehead: Science and the Modern World
topics.short: How modern science grew from older beliefs about order in nature, and what its picture of the world leaves out.

topics.title: Barth: The Word of God and the Word of Man
topics.short: A Swiss theologian's addresses calling preachers back from their own words to the word of God.

topics.title: Heidegger: What Is Metaphysics?
topics.short: A lecture that asks why there is something rather than nothing, and what our moods reveal.

topics.title: Dewey: Experience and Education
topics.short: Not all experience educates: a short book on what good schooling, old or new, should do.

topics.title: Wittgenstein: Philosophical Investigations
topics.short: Meaning is use: words as tools in 'language games', and many philosophical puzzles as tangles in language.

topics.title: Poincaré: Science and Hypothesis
topics.short: What role do conventions, hypotheses and experiments play in mathematics and physics?

topics.title: Whitehead: An Introduction to Mathematics
topics.short: A short book on why mathematics is about patterns, from variables and functions to the series behind waves.

topics.title: Einstein: Relativity
topics.short: Einstein's own popular explanation: trains, lightning flashes, clocks, and gravity as the shape of space and time.

topics.title: Eddington: The Expanding Universe
topics.short: The galaxies are rushing apart: an astronomer explains the new discovery to general readers.

topics.title: Bohr: Atomic Theory and the Discussion with Einstein
topics.short: The quantum atom, complementarity, and Bohr's long friendly argument with Einstein.

topics.title: Dobzhansky: Genetics and the Origin of Species
topics.short: Darwin's selection joined to Mendel's genes: how variation in populations makes new species.

topics.title: Hardy: A Mathematician's Apology
topics.short: A great mathematician defends pure mathematics for its beauty, and looks back on his life's work.

topics.title: Schrödinger: What Is Life?
topics.short: A physicist asks how living things keep order, and guesses that genes hold a code in a molecule.

topics.title: Planck: Scientific Autobiography
topics.short: The founder of quantum theory looks back on his discovery and on how new ideas win acceptance.

topics.title: Heisenberg: Physics and Philosophy
topics.short: The uncertainty principle and what quantum physics means for old questions about matter.

topics.title: Waddington: The Nature of Life
topics.short: A biologist explains genes, development and evolution, and how a single cell becomes a body.

topics.title: Veblen: The Theory of the Leisure Class
topics.short: Why people buy things to show off: Veblen's idea of 'conspicuous consumption.'

topics.title: Tawney: The Acquisitive Society
topics.short: A historian argues that an economy should serve purposes beyond getting; the lesson gives the replies too.

topics.title: Keynes: The General Theory
topics.short: Why whole economies can stay stuck with high unemployment, and how economists of other schools replied.

topics.title: Frazer: The Golden Bough
topics.short: A vast comparison of myths and customs, and why later anthropologists questioned its method.

topics.title: Weber: Essays in Sociology
topics.short: Politics and science as vocations, authority, bureaucracy and the role of ideas in history.

topics.title: Huizinga: The Waning of the Middle Ages
topics.short: Life, thought and art in 14th- and 15th-century France and the Low Countries, seen as a late autumn.

topics.title: Lévi-Strauss: Structural Anthropology
topics.short: Looking for the hidden patterns, like those of a language, under kinship and myth.

topics.title: Conrad: Heart of Darkness
topics.short: A voyage up the Congo River to find a man named Kurtz, and an indictment of colonial greed.

topics.title: Chekhov: Uncle Vanya
topics.short: On a country estate, people who gave their lives to work wonder what it was for, and go on working.

topics.title: Henry James: The Beast in the Jungle
topics.short: A man waits all his life for something great to happen to him, and misses what was there.

topics.title: Mann: Death in Venice
topics.short: A famous, disciplined writer on holiday loses his self-command in a city under a hidden plague.

topics.title: Proust: Swann in Love
topics.short: A man of taste falls for a woman he doesn't even like, and jealousy and memory take over.

topics.title: Joyce: A Portrait of the Artist as a Young Man
topics.short: Stephen Dedalus grows from a small boy into a young man who chooses art over family, faith and nation.

topics.title: Pirandello: Six Characters in Search of an Author
topics.short: Six characters left unfinished by their author interrupt a rehearsal and demand their story be played.

topics.title: Shaw: Saint Joan
topics.short: Joan of Arc as a farm girl of plain good sense, and the people who tried her, each convinced they were right.

topics.title: Cather: A Lost Lady
topics.short: A boy in a Nebraska railroad town watches a charming woman, and the pioneer era, fade.

topics.title: Kafka: The Metamorphosis
topics.short: Gregor Samsa wakes up as a giant insect, and his family must decide what he still is to them.

topics.title: D. H. Lawrence: The Prussian Officer
topics.short: A young orderly and the officer who torments him, in a story of cruelty and pride before the Great War.

topics.title: T. S. Eliot: The Waste Land
topics.short: A poem of broken voices after the First World War, built from fragments of older poems.

topics.title: Fitzgerald: The Great Gatsby
topics.short: A mysterious rich man throws parties to win back the woman he loved, told by the neighbor who watches.

topics.title: Woolf: To the Lighthouse
topics.short: A family's summers by the sea, ten years apart, told through the flow of their thoughts.

topics.title: Faulkner: A Rose for Emily
topics.short: A Southern town tells the story of the strange old woman it watched for decades.

topics.title: O'Neill: Mourning Becomes Electra
topics.short: Aeschylus' Oresteia retold in New England after the Civil War, a family undone by its past.

topics.title: Hemingway: The Short Happy Life of Francis Macomber
topics.short: On an African safari, a man shamed by his fear finds his courage, briefly.

topics.title: Brecht: Mother Courage and Her Children
topics.short: A canteen woman pulls her wagon through the Thirty Years' War, trying to profit from it.

topics.title: Orwell: Animal Farm
topics.short: The animals drive out the farmer, and the pigs slowly become what they replaced.

topics.title: Beckett: Waiting for Godot
topics.short: Two tramps wait by a tree for someone who never comes, and fill the time with talk.
